svg.title: Lumen screen probes: radiance atlas
svg.desc: Captured buffer visualization. Lumen screen probes: radiance atlas graph 0001 | Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ScreenProbeRadiance | pass 168 | linear radiance radiance (shared per-figure tonemap) INVALID_LIGHTING sentinel valid zero non-finite ScreenProbeRadiance is the 640x672 octahedral probe atlas (80x84 probes x 8x8 texels). It stores radiance, not irradiance. The exact INVALID_LIGHTING triple (65024,65024,64512) is masked as a categorical invalid tile; a valid zero radiance remains black. The atlas is 640x672 texels, not a screen image; the octahedral 8x8 texel blocks are visible at native resolution.
